تحتملي (form VIII)
# تَحْتَمِلِي (taḥtamilī) /taħ.ta.mi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# تُحْتَمَلِي (tuḥtamalī) /tuħ.ta.ma.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
